title: Free Yoneda comparison of small categorical Cech differentials
statement: For the category $C$, family $\pi_i:U_i\to X$, and free presheaf chain complex $K$ of [lem-sc-small-cech-free-exact], let $P:C^{op}\to\mathrm{Ab}_v$ be any presheaf. Let $L$ be the categorical categorical Cech cochain complex of this family with values in $P$. Define $e_n:\operatorname{Hom}(K_n,P)\simeq_+ L^n$ by evaluating a natural transformation on the identity generator in each represented product, then identifying those sections with the categorical product by its universal property. For every $n\in\mathbb N$ and $a:K_n\to P$, one has $e_{n+1}(d_{n+1,n}\circ a)=d_L^n(e_n(a))$.

proof.text: Construct the free Yoneda additive equivalence by evaluating a transformation on identity generators. Construct its inverse by applying the presheaf restriction map to each supplied section and extending linearly to the free group. Naturality and the generator universal property prove the two inverse identities.
Use the explicit dependent-function product limit cone to obtain the categorical product comparison. Its inverse followed by a product projection is evaluation at that index.

Naturality of a transformation shows that precomposition by every free face map corresponds to the restriction map along the underlying product projection. Expand both alternating differentials, use additivity to pass through sums and integer multiples, and apply product extensionality and the projection identity to equate every summand.
